description.en: Records a scoring-play history entry for a match member (e.g. who scored/assisted a goal), by team slot, two small numeric codes and the character ID, used to drive post-match goal-scorer summaries.
Index of the team/side the entry belongs to.
First numeric history code (meaning not confirmed, likely an event/role type).
Second numeric history code (meaning not confirmed).
Character ID string of the involved member.
Optional extra flag for the entry; only read when at least 5 arguments are given.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 3 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Record a scoring-play history entry crediting a specific player
CMND_BTL_SET_POINT_HISTORY(0, 1, 10, "para_cp0008");
